_comment: Each item is auto-derived from repo signals by generate-tracker.mjs. type 'grep' searches file contents under `scope` for `pattern` (plain substring). type 'exists' checks a path. type 'manual' is not auto-derivable and keeps a hand-set status until someone updates it here.
